result.question: What was the curse of Jotham?

readings.answer: That fire would come from Abimelech to consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and fire from the leaders to consume Abimelech.
readings.support: may fire come from Abimelech and consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo | may fire come from the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo and consume Abimelech

assessments.reason: The answer matches the text: “may fire come from Abimelech and consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo … and may fire come from the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo and consume Abimelech,” describing the reciprocal fire curse.

result.reason: Verse 9:20 explicitly states Jotham’s curse as mutual destruction by fire between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo.
